description: What goes wrong with this car? Summarises owner-filed safety complaints to NHTSA for a make, model and model year: total complaints, crashes, fires, injuries and deaths reported, the most-complained-about components, and the latest complaints with their text. For used-car buyers, owners and researchers. Source: NHTSA Office of Defects Investigation complaints. Complaints are unverified owner reports, not proven defects, and counts partly reflect how many cars were sold. (cost: 1 credit)

limit.description: integer, optional, latest complaints to list, 1-50, default 10

make.description: string, required, vehicle make, e.g. honda

model.description: string, required, US model name, e.g. accord

name: vehicle_complaints
